clips.caption:
Same words. A dozen different names for who you're saying them to. Trust the universe. Trust consciousness. Trust God. Trust Allah, Yahweh, Krishna, Vishnu, the Atman — pick whichever one is yours. Underneath all of them, it's the same prayer.

The courage to change what you can. The patience to accept what you can't. The wisdom to know the difference. Put it on your wall, in your car, say it until you stop thinking about the words — a hundred times a day if that's what it takes. Nothing has to be perfect today. It only means it isn't finished yet.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the version most people never finish learning.
